meaningKo: 위험을 감수하다, 남들이 반대하는 의견을 내다
exampleEn: I'm going out on a limb by proposing a new idea in the meeting.
exampleKo: 회의에서 새로운 아이디어를 제안하며 위험을 감수하고 있어요.
gameExamples: To succeed in this business, you have to go out on a limb and take some risks.
I decided to go out on a limb by supporting the controversial candidate in the election.
She was willing to go out on a limb and share her unconventional opinions during the discussion.
